newsitem.title: USA: MedPartners to acquire Aetna unit.
newsitem.headline: MedPartners to acquire Aetna unit.

text.p: MedPartners Inc will acquire Aetna Professional Management Corp, a unit of Aetna Inc, and most of the HealthWays Family Medical Centers and affiliated group practices, the companies said Wednesday.

They also announced that MedPartners and Aetna U.S. Healthcare, the health business unit of Aetna Inc, had entered into a 10-year, national strategic provider relationship that will allow some Aetna U.S. Healthcare members to use MedPartners physicians.
Terms of the acquisition were not disclosed.
The acquisition is expected to close during the second quarter, pending regulatory approvals.
